topic: RLM (recursive language models: a model that programmatically inspects and recursively calls itself over a long prompt held in an external environment) versus CLM (Context Language Models, introduced in a September 2026 paper by Shao et al.: language models that natively manage their own context by treating the context as a file the model can update, with suffix cache reuse for serving). Overlaps, similarities, distinctions, and validity as improvements for production coding: qualitative differences, cost efficiency, ability to reuse traces, and similar practical criteria.

guidance.emphasis: Say plainly what the literature establishes and what it does not; cite only retrieved sources. Be explicit about which claims concern production coding specifically.
